stem: A client with serious bleeding after enoxaparin receives protamine sulfate. Which nursing interpretation is most accurate after the protamine is given?

options.A: Protamine completely neutralizes all enoxaparin anti-factor Xa activity, so further bleeding assessment is unnecessary
options.B: Enoxaparin reversal is incomplete; anti-factor Xa activity may persist, so the nurse must continue assessing bleeding and the client's response while also watching for protamine reactions
options.C: Protamine has no clinically meaningful effect on enoxaparin and therefore should never be used for enoxaparin-associated bleeding
options.D: Once protamine is started, severe hypotension or anaphylactoid reactions are no longer relevant safety concerns

rationale: Protamine can largely neutralize enoxaparin, but current labeling states that anti-factor Xa activity is never completely neutralized and reaches only about 60% maximal neutralization. Ongoing bleeding assessment remains necessary. Protamine itself can cause severe hypotension and anaphylactoid reactions, so administration requires appropriate monitoring and resuscitation capability.
educational_objective: Recognize that protamine provides incomplete reversal of enoxaparin and requires continued bleeding and adverse-reaction monitoring.
source_locator: Section 10 Overdosage — protamine may largely neutralize enoxaparin; anti-Factor Xa activity never completely neutralized, maximum about 60%; protamine may cause severe hypotensive/anaphylactoid reactions
source_claim_supported: Protamine incompletely reverses enoxaparin anti-Xa activity and carries important infusion-reaction risk.

correction_summary: Preserved the valid partial-reversal concept but converted it into a post-antidote monitoring decision and added the clinically important protamine reaction risk.
audit_reviewer: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol — Rule 1 clinical audit + adversarial second pass

audit_findings.source_audit: Current DailyMed Lovenox overdosage section verified.
audit_findings.claim_by_claim: Incomplete anti-Xa reversal and protamine adverse reactions directly supported.
audit_findings.choice_C: Incorrect; protamine can largely neutralize enoxaparin.
audit_findings.choice_D: Incorrect; serious protamine reactions remain possible.
audit_findings.ambiguity_second_answer: Only B captures both incomplete reversal and monitoring need.
audit_findings.independent_adversarial_second_pass: Checked timing-dependent protamine dosing, anti-Xa versus aPTT, ongoing hemorrhage and protamine toxicity; no unresolved conflict.
